operations.from: Hair grows in a three-phase cycle — anagen (active growth), catagen, and telogen (resting). The laser emits light energy absorbed by melanin in the hair follicle and shaft, damaging the follicle and reducing regrowth. Follicles in the anagen phase respond best, so multiple treatments are needed.
operations.reason: Restore the source's explanation of catagen and the hair shaft; retain the mechanism.

operations.from:
Dr. Hamdi completed her Family Medicine residency at the University of Calgary in 2015, followed by additional training (R3) in maternity and newborn care. She has practised family medicine in Calgary ever since, and joined Blue Diamond Medical in 2023.

She also works in the Labour and Delivery unit at Peter Lougheed Hospital and maintains a shared-care practice with the Lougheed Maternity Group (LMG).

Dr. Hamdi is board certified by the College of Family Physicians of Canada (CFPC) and has been granted Fellowship of the College (FCFP). She is an Assistant Clinical Professor at the University of Calgary and holds a Master's degree in Health Science Education from the University of Alberta.

She cares for a wide range of health concerns, including chronic disease, women's health (contraceptive management and IUD insertion, menopause, and prenatal and maternity care), well-child visits, and mental health. She is also certified to provide Botox injections for pain management as well as cosmetic indications.
